payload.artist_html: Y.-J. Lan, G. Mayr & C.-H. Tsai
payload.credit_html: "A new Pleistocene peafowl from Taiwan reveals the extinction of a large galliform bird in East Asia"
payload.description_html: The general outline of the left humerus of Pavo miejue and extant peafowls in caudal view. (a) Pavo miejue (holotype, NTUM-VP 241105); (b) male Pavo cristatus (NTUM-VP 2602081); (c) female Pavo muticus (SMF 22272); (d) female Afropavo congensis (SMF 4519). bc, bicipital crest; cg, capital groove; dp, distal projection of the humeral head; dptf, dorsal pneumotricipital fossa; hh, humeral head; mi, muscular imprint; nf, nutrient foramen; ptf, pneumotricipital fossa. Scale bar represents 50 mm.
